structural_reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity, whereas repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1). Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure: CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).
Repurchase program suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary repurchase requests are not accepted, so participant liquidity depends on the program reopening. Capacity is 0%. Gating precedent on top (3.3).
Early repurchase economics: 5% if held < 1 year (2.7). Relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
scenario_reasons: Capacity: repurchases are suspended (cell 3.1): ordinary requests are not accepted. Capacity is 0% until the program reopens.
Scenario demand (illustrative): 7.2% of the position per year vs 0% annual wrapper capacity. EXCEEDS: repurchases are closed, so every request waits for the program to reopen.

Scenario verdict (ILLUSTRATIVE, this plan): misaligned. It moves with the sliders and the plan. Proration assumption: an oversubscribed offer is filled pro rata and the unfilled remainder waits for the next window.
